name: EspoCRM
description: EspoCRM is a free and open-source CRM platform.
composeYaml:
services:
  espocrm:
    image: 'espocrm/espocrm:10'
    container_name: espocrm
    environment:
      - 'ESPOCRM_ADMIN_USERNAME=${ESPOCRM_ADMIN_USERNAME:-admin}'
      - 'ESPOCRM_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${ADMIN_PASSWORD}'
      - ESPOCRM_DATABASE_PLATFORM=Mysql
      - ESPOCRM_DATABASE_HOST=espocrm-db
      - 'ESPOCRM_DATABASE_NAME=${MARIADB_DATABASE:-espocrm}'
      - 'ESPOCRM_DATABASE_USER=${MARIADB_USER}'
      - 'ESPOCRM_DATABASE_PASSWORD=${MARIADB_PASSWORD}'
      - 'ESPOCRM_SITE_URL=${APP_URL}'
    volumes:
      - 'espocrm-data:/var/www/html/data'
      - 'espocrm-custom:/var/www/html/custom'
      - 'espocrm-custom-client:/var/www/html/client/custom'
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      espocrm-db:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - bin/command
        - app-check
      start_period: 20s
      interval: 60s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 3
  espocrm-daemon:
    image: 'espocrm/espocrm:10'
    container_name: espocrm-daemon
    volumes_from:
      - espocrm
    restart: unless-stopped
    entrypoint: docker-daemon.sh
    depends_on:
      espocrm:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - bin/command
        - app-check
      start_period: 20s
      interval: 180s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 3
  espocrm-websocket:
    image: 'espocrm/espocrm:10'
    container_name: espocrm-websocket
    environment:
      - ESPOCRM_CONFIG_USE_WEB_SOCKET=true
      - ESPOCRM_CONFIG_WEB_SOCKET_URL=${APP_URL}
      - 'ESPOCRM_CONFIG_WEB_SOCKET_ZERO_M_Q_SUBSCRIBER_DSN=tcp://*:7777'
      - 'ESPOCRM_CONFIG_WEB_SOCKET_ZERO_M_Q_SUBMISSION_DSN=tcp://espocrm-websocket:7777'
    volumes_from:
      - espocrm
    restart: unless-stopped
    entrypoint: docker-websocket.sh
    depends_on:
      espocrm:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - bin/command
        - app-check
      start_period: 20s
      interval: 180s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 3
  espocrm-db:
    image: 'mariadb:12.3'
    container_name: espocrm-db
    environment:
      - 'MARIADB_DATABASE=${MARIADB_DATABASE:-espocrm}'
      - 'MARIADB_USER=${MARIADB_USER}'
      - 'MARIADB_PASSWORD=${MARIADB_PASSWORD}'
      - 'MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD=${ROOT_PASSWORD}'
    volumes:
      - 'espocrm-db:/var/lib/mysql'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - healthcheck.sh
        - '--connect'
        - '--innodb_initialized'
      interval: 20s
      start_period: 10s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3

meta.about: CRM with a frontend designed as a single page application, and a REST API.
